test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'KAPIL' is written as 'NDRKN' and 'SAROJ' is written as 'VDTQL'. How will 'POOJA' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'KAPIL' is written as 'NDRKN'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d14da1d9355198ba5215d3cdc9fd458b5e4d8a59004d78cdfe0786ebc38bab5c.png] 

And

'SAROJ' is written as 'VDTQL'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62c2ebb22350416e0255ac55b56309b1ee891c8c5e91dc4b3581d93cc5451651.png] 

Similarly,

'POOJA' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79003f9d13857a23d4ff5f743b805813aea403da9e71f5e6d40891f07d71688c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SRQLC".**
